```{r case_count_analyses_monthly}
# every row/column pair to cross-tabulate
crosstab_pairs <- list(
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "END_RISK_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "END_RISK_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "END_RISK_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_6")
)

make_crosstab <- function(row_var, col_var, data = six_month_outcomes) {
  # keep only rows where BOTH variables have a valid (non-missing)
  # response -- USERIDs with NA on either side are dropped entirely
  # rather than shown as a "missing" row/column in the table
  filtered <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[row_var]]), !is.na(.data[[col_var]])) %>%
    select(all_of(c(row_var, col_var)))

  # tbl_cross() requires at least 1 row -- if no USERID has valid
  # responses on both variables at once, skip this pair rather than
  # erroring out
  if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", row_var, " x ", col_var,
            ": no rows with valid responses on both variables.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  filtered %>%
    tbl_cross(
      row     = all_of(row_var),
      col     = all_of(col_var),
      percent = "row",     # cell percentages (of the table total)
      digits  = c(0, 1),    # 0 decimals for N, 1 decimal for %
      missing = "no"        # safety net: don't add a "missing" row/col
    ) %>%
    bold_labels() %>%
    modify_caption(paste0("**", row_var, " x ", col_var, "**"))
}

crosstab_names <- sapply(crosstab_pairs, paste, collapse = "_vs_")
crosstab_list  <- lapply(crosstab_pairs, function(p) make_crosstab(p[1], p[2]))
names(crosstab_list) <- crosstab_names

# drop any pairs that had no valid overlapping data (see message() output
# above for which ones, if any, were skipped)
crosstab_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), crosstab_list)

# In an R Markdown / Quarto chunk, or at the RStudio console, each table
# renders as a clean formatted table with a caption, row/column labels,
# totals, and "N (pct%)" cells, restricted to valid responses only:
crosstab_list[["JOURNEY_INCREASE_1_vs_END_RISK_1"]]

# to view/render every table in sequence (e.g. in an R Markdown chunk
# with results='asis'):
for (tbl in crosstab_list){
  
  print(tbl)
  
}



```

```{r Daily_Case_Count_Plot_Low}
print_range_avg <- function(data, col_name, label) {
  vals <- data[[col_name]]
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) {
    cat(label, ": no valid data\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-55s Range: %6s to %-6s | Average: %s\n",
              label, round(min(vals), 2), round(max(vals), 2), round(mean(vals), 2)))
}

window_suffixes <- c("1WK", "2WK", "1", "3", "6")

for (s in window_suffixes) {
  print_range_avg(daily_cases_low_feeling, paste0("SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_", s),
                   paste0("Comp Journey Use (Sum) -- BEFORE ", s))
  print_range_avg(daily_cases_low_feeling, paste0("SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_", s),
                   paste0("Comp Journey Use (Sum) -- AFTER ", s))
  print_range_avg(daily_cases_low_feeling, paste0("COUNT_FEELING1_BEFORE_", s),
                   paste0("# Times FEELINGRATING = 1 -- BEFORE ", s))
  print_range_avg(daily_cases_low_feeling, paste0("COUNT_FEELING1_AFTER_", s),
                   paste0("# Times FEELINGRATING = 1 -- AFTER ", s))
}

for (s in window_suffixes) {

  print_range_avg(daily_cases_low_feeling, paste0("COUNT_FEELING2_AFTER_", s),
                   paste0("# Times FEELINGRATING = 2 -- AFTER ", s))
}
```

# Low Mood and Usage Correlations

```{r Low_Mood_Usage_Correlations}

Outcomes <- c("MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_2WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_2WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6")

Pred <- daily_cases_low_feeling[, which(grepl("SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_", names(daily_cases_low_feeling)) | names(daily_cases_low_feeling) %in% Outcomes)]

Cors_list <- NULL

for (i in Outcomes) {
  
  ctest_M <- corr.test(Pred)
  r_value_M <- round(ctest_M$r[, i], 4)
  p_value_M <- round(ctest_M$p[, i], 4)
  n_value_M <- ctest_M$n[, i]
  
  Low_Mood_Cors <- data.frame(Correlation = r_value_M, P_Value = p_value_M, N = n_value_M, Outcome = i)
  
  Low_Mood_Cors$Predictor <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(Low_Mood_Cors))
  
  Cors_list[[i]] <- Low_Mood_Cors
  
}

Low_Mood_Cors_DF <- do.call(rbind, Cors_list)

rownames(Low_Mood_Cors_DF) <- NULL

Low_Mood_Cors_DF <- Low_Mood_Cors_DF[which(grepl("MEAN_", Low_Mood_Cors_DF$Outcome) & grepl("SUM_", Low_Mood_Cors_DF$Predictor) & Low_Mood_Cors_DF$P_Value < .1),]

```

# Rolling Min Mood and Usage Correlations

```{r Rolling_Min_Usage_Correlations}

Outcomes <- c("MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_2WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_2WK", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3", "MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6")

Pred <- daily_cases_rolling_min[, which(grepl("SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_", names(daily_cases_rolling_min)) | names(daily_cases_rolling_min) %in% Outcomes)]

Cors_list <- NULL

for (i in Outcomes) {
  
  ctest_M <- corr.test(Pred)
  r_value_M <- round(ctest_M$r[, i], 4)
  p_value_M <- round(ctest_M$p[, i], 4)
  n_value_M <- ctest_M$n[, i]
  
  rolling_min_cors <- data.frame(Correlation = r_value_M, P_Value = p_value_M, N = n_value_M, Outcome = i)
  
  rolling_min_cors$Predictor <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(rolling_min_cors))
  
  Cors_list[[i]] <- rolling_min_cors
  
}

rolling_min_cors_DF <- do.call(rbind, Cors_list)

rownames(rolling_min_cors_DF) <- NULL

rolling_min_cors_DF <- rolling_min_cors_DF[which(grepl("MEAN_", rolling_min_cors_DF$Outcome) & grepl("SUM_", rolling_min_cors_DF$Predictor) & rolling_min_cors_DF$P_Value < .1),]

rolling_min_cors_DF <- rolling_min_cors_DF %>%
  select(Outcome, Predictor, everything()) %>%
  arrange(Outcome, desc(Correlation))

```

```{r Daily_Mood_Rating_Descriptives}

Comp_DF %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEELINGRATING)) %>%
  distinct(USERID, FEELINGRATING) %>%
  count(FEELINGRATING, name = "N_USERIDS") %>%
  mutate(PCT_USERIDS = round(100 * N_USERIDS / n_distinct(Comp_DF$USERID), 1))

# How many different ratings do most users report

Comp_DF %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEELINGRATING)) %>%
  distinct(USERID, FEELINGRATING) %>%
  count(USERID, name = "N_DISTINCT_VALUES") %>%
  summarise(
    AVG_DISTINCT_VALUES    = mean(N_DISTINCT_VALUES),
    MEDIAN_DISTINCT_VALUES = median(N_DISTINCT_VALUES)
  )

Comp_DF %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEELINGRATING)) %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  summarise(
    N_DISTINCT_VALUES  = n_distinct(FEELINGRATING),  # distinct FEELINGRATING values reported
    N_TOTAL_RESPONSES  = n(),                        # total FEELINGRATING responses (all rows, incl. repeats)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(N_DISTINCT_VALUES) %>%
  summarise(
    N_USERIDS            = n(),
    AVG_TOTAL_RESPONSES  = round(mean(N_TOTAL_RESPONSES), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(PCT_USERIDS = round(100 * N_USERIDS / sum(N_USERIDS), 1)) %>%
  arrange(N_DISTINCT_VALUES) %>%
  select(N_DISTINCT_VALUES, N_USERIDS, PCT_USERIDS, AVG_TOTAL_RESPONSES)

```
